create_SimulationStepFn: create a SimulationStepFn instance to advance the TORAX simulation one time step with solver, time_step_calculator, runtime_params_provider, and geometry_provider
run_SimulationStepFn_call: run the SimulationStepFn __call__ method to advance the simulation state one time step and return updated SimState and PostProcessedOutputs
run_SimulationStepFn_fixed_time_step: run the SimulationStepFn fixed_time_step method to advance the simulation by a specified dt using repeated single steps
run_SimulationStepFn_adaptive_step: run the SimulationStepFn _adaptive_step method to perform an adaptive simulation step with dt-backtracking for convergence
run_SimulationStepFn_check_for_errors: run the SimulationStepFn check_for_errors method to check for low-temperature collapse, state errors, and solver convergence errors
